% Shaded overrides of the original-template baseline.
\def\thesis@fontsystem{tx}
\def\thesis@headingfamily{\sffamily}
\def\thesis@chapterlayout{fncychap}
\def\thesis@fncychapstyle{Bjornstrup}

% This is a ñapa generated by me as I think the chapter title size in Bjornstrup is just too small
% Increase Bjornstrup chapter-title font size for the shaded style only.
\AtBeginDocument{%
  \ChTitleVar{\raggedleft\Huge\sffamily\bfseries}%
}

% The following legacy chapter size/spacing values still control the TOC title.
% Actual chapter headings use the selected fncychap design and its defaults.
\def\thesis@chaptertitlesize{24} % was 24
\def\thesis@chaptertitleleading{29} % was 29
\def\thesis@chapternumbersize{12}
\def\thesis@chapternumberleading{15}
\def\thesis@chapterbefore{20pt}
\def\thesis@chaptergap{12pt}
\def\thesis@chapterafter{20pt}
\def\thesis@sectionsize{14}
\def\thesis@sectionbefore{2.5ex plus .8ex minus .2ex}
\def\thesis@sectionafter{.8ex plus .2ex}
\def\thesis@subsectionbefore{2ex plus .5ex minus .2ex}
\def\thesis@subsectionafter{.6ex plus .2ex}
\def\thesis@toclayout{shaded}
\def\thesis@tocchaptergap{6pt}
\def\thesis@tocentrygap{0pt}
\def\thesis@headerlayout{navigation}
\def\thesis@headerfont{\footnotesize\sffamily}
\def\thesis@headerrule{.4pt}
\def\thesis@sectionleading{17}
\def\thesis@subsectionleading{15}
\def\thesis@subsubsectionleading{13}
\def\thesis@tocchapterfont{\thesis@headingfamily\thesis@headingweight}
\def\thesis@tocchapterpagefont{\thesis@headingfamily\thesis@headingweight}
\def\thesis@tocchapterdotsep{\cftdotsep}
\def\thesis@tocchapnumwidth{2.6em}
\def\thesis@tocsecindent{2.6em}
\def\thesis@tocsecnumwidth{3em}
\def\thesis@tocsubsecindent{5.6em}
\def\thesis@tocsubsecnumwidth{4em}
\def\thesis@tocsubsubsecindent{9.6em}
\def\thesis@tocsubsubsecnumwidth{5em}
